title: Industrial
summary: Particulate and process filtration for plants, warehouses and technical areas.
paragraphs: In industrial environments, filtration protects both product and equipment. Dust, fumes and fine particles can affect quality, safety and asset life, so systems must match process flow and contamination profiles.

Tracking differential pressure and sizing housings correctly helps avoid premature filter change-outs and damage to downstream equipment. BasicAir helps specify suitable air filters and maintenance approaches for industrial sites.
